topic: The Great Mosque of Cordoba was begun in 784-785 CE by Abd al-Rahman I. It is famous for its forest of red-and-white striped arches. Show endless arches and soft light.

episode.title: Cordoba Ki Masjid: Mehraabon Ka Jungle

shots.narration: ایک مسجد، جس کے اندر محرابوں کا جنگل ہے!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, family-film-quality 3D animation, interior of the Great Mosque of Cordoba, deep rows of red-and-white striped double-tiered arches, soft golden light, empty architecture, no writing or human figures.
shots.action: Soft sunlight spreads across the repeating arches.
shots.mood: Warm golden illumination and an inviting architectural mystery.

shots.narration: نانا ابو، مسجد میں جنگل کیسے ہو سکتا ہے؟
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, warm Pakistani home, Areeba in a yellow shalwar kameez and light-pink dupatta beside Nana Abbu, an ordinary grandfather with a neat white beard, round glasses, cream kurta and brown waistcoat; an open wordless architectural picture album rests between them.
shots.action: Areeba points at the picture of repeating arches.
shots.mood: Curious raised eyebrows in gentle lamplight.

shots.narration: [chuckles] درختوں کا نہیں، بیٹا، محرابوں کا جنگل!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, family-film-quality 3D animation, the same cozy home and open wordless album, Nana Abbu seated beside Areeba, warm oil-lamp glow, no text.
shots.action: Nana Abbu traces the pictured row of arches with one finger.
shots.mood: A kind smile and a playful moment of understanding.

shots.narration: یہ اسپین کے شہر قرطبہ کی عظیم مسجد ہے۔
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, family-film-quality 3D animation, historic Great Mosque of Cordoba exterior beside its courtyard, warm stone walls and garden greenery, no people, signs or writing.
shots.action: A courtyard tree sways gently beside the mosque.
shots.mood: Peaceful historic setting in warm afternoon light.

shots.narration: اسے عبدالرحمٰن اول نے بنوانا شروع کروایا تھا۔
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, respectful architectural view of the Great Mosque of Cordoba, warm stone masonry and an arched entrance, historical subject is its founding by Abd al-Rahman I in 784-785 CE, no depiction of the founder, no people or writing.
shots.action: Sunlight moves slowly across the stone entrance.
shots.mood: Calm admiration expressed through golden stone and soft shadows.

shots.narration: [excited] یہ کام 784-785 عیسوی میں شروع ہوا تھا!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, family-film-quality 3D animation, close architectural view inside the Great Mosque of Cordoba, red-and-white striped arches rising above stone columns, no people, numerals or text.
shots.action: A shaft of light reveals the curved striped stonework.
shots.mood: A gentle sense of discovery in luminous warm light.

shots.narration: دیکھو، محرابوں پر سرخ اور سفید دھاریاں ہیں۔
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, close-up of authentic red-and-white striped arches in the Great Mosque of Cordoba, smooth curved stone sections, softly blurred columns behind, no figures or writing.
shots.action: A soft highlight travels along the alternating colored sections.
shots.mood: Clear, beautiful red-and-white patterns in soft illumination.

shots.narration: اور پیچھے دیکھو، محرابوں کے بعد پھر محرابیں!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, long interior aisle of the Great Mosque of Cordoba, repeating double-tiered red-and-white arches extending deep into the distance, empty floor, no figures or writing.
shots.action: Warm light gradually reveals the distant rows.
shots.mood: An expansive view filled with rhythmic arches and gentle shadows.

shots.narration: [whispers] نرم روشنی میں یہ منظر کتنا خوب صورت لگتا ہے۔
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, family-film-quality 3D animation, quiet interior of the Great Mosque of Cordoba, striped arches framing pools of soft golden light on the floor, no people or writing.
shots.action: Tiny dust motes drift through a sunbeam.
shots.mood: Hushed golden stillness with soft-edged shadows.

shots.narration: اسی لیے یہ محرابیں اتنی مشہور ہیں۔
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, wide symmetrical view of the Great Mosque of Cordoba's forest of red-and-white striped arches, layered columns and softly illuminated depths, no figures or text.
shots.action: Daylight brightens the central row of arches.
shots.mood: A satisfying grand view of the repeating architectural pattern.

shots.narration: اب سمجھ آیا، یہ واقعی محرابوں کا جنگل ہے!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, return to the cozy Pakistani home, Areeba and Nana Abbu beside the wordless architectural album, a closed plain book nearby, warm oil-lamp light, no lettering.
shots.action: Areeba spreads her hands over the album's wide picture of arches.
shots.mood: Areeba's delighted smile and Nana Abbu's affectionate expression.

shots.narration: [excited] نانا ابو، پرانے زمانے میں کتابیں کیسے بنتی تھیں؟
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, family-film-quality 3D animation, the same warm home, Nana Abbu and Areeba beside the album and a plain closed hand-bound book with no title or markings.
shots.action: Areeba points toward the hand-bound book.
shots.mood: Bright curiosity beside a softly glowing lamp.

episode.endHook: Agli baar: purane zamane mein kitabein kaise banti theen?
episode.description: قرطبہ کی عظیم مسجد کی تعمیر عبدالرحمٰن اول نے 784-785 عیسوی میں شروع کروائی۔ نانا ابو اور اریبہ کے ساتھ اس کی سرخ اور سفید محرابوں اور نرم روشنی کا حسن دیکھیے۔
